research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Nephrogen is researching systems, methods, and compositions for de-repressing PKD1, as described in the title, by providing a system for inhibiting a miRNA-17 family miRNA from binding to the 3'UTR of PKD1. The abstract details a gRNA and a polynucleotide-programmable nucleotide-binding domain that modifies the miRNA binding site, aiming to alter gene expression relevant to kidney diseases. These efforts focus on gene therapy approaches for kidney disease treatment.
